title: Fixes to workforce housing law chapter 2.96
summary: The Housing Advisory Board reviewed proposed changes to chapter 2.96, the residential workforce housing law, including defining area median income and fixing fee waiver references. The meeting adjourned early over a Sunshine Law concern, and all items are to be reposted for a future meeting.

timeline.text: Staff confirmed the next meeting is June 26.
All items discussed at this meeting will be reposted for another time.
Adjournment due to a meeting link problem and Sunshine Law concern: The chair adjourned the meeting so the items can be reposted for another time.
The department proposed defining area median income, a term used throughout chapter 2.96 but not defined.
The department said Bill 88, a fee waiver bill, has not yet been added to the code.
The department said other parts of county code wrongly point to chapter 2.96 for fee waiver definitions.
The department said one proposed fix matters because it relates to fee waivers.
The board is reviewing a department chart of proposed changes to chapter 2.96, the county's residential workforce housing law.
